translations.EN: Waiting here now.
translations.TL: Naghihintay na ako rito ngayon.

translations.EN: Currently holding position and waiting.
translations.TL: Kasalukuyang nakapwesto at naghihintay.

translations.EN: Standing by at the designated spot.
translations.TL: Nakahanda sa itinalagang pwesto.

translations.EN: Waiting at this location as ordered.
translations.TL: Naghihintay sa lugar na ito ayon sa utos.

translations.EN: Keeping watch while waiting right here.
translations.TL: Nagbabantay habang naghihintay dito mismo.

translations.EN: Holding at the marker.
translations.TL: Hawak ang pwesto sa marka.

translations.EN: Waiting quietly. Eyes open.
translations.TL: Naghihintay nang tahimik. Bukas ang mga mata.

translations.EN: In position and waiting.
translations.TL: Nasa pwesto at naghihintay.

translations.EN: Stationary at the post.
translations.TL: Nakatigil sa posteng ito.

translations.EN: Waiting here. Take your time.
translations.TL: Naghihintay rito. Huwag magmadali.

translations.EN: Okay, I'll wait there.
translations.TL: Sige, maghihintay ako roon.

translations.EN: Understood. Moving to the waiting spot.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Papatungo sa pwesto ng paghihintay.

translations.EN: I'll go stand by over there.
translations.TL: Pupunta ako roon para maghintay.

translations.EN: All right, I'll wait at that position.
translations.TL: Sige, maghihintay ako sa posisyong iyon.

translations.EN: Heading to the waypoint to wait.
translations.TL: Papatungo sa marka para maghintay.

translations.EN: Understood. I will hold that ground.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Hahawakan ko ang lupang iyon.

translations.EN: Right. Setting up to wait there.
translations.TL: Sige. Mag-aayos para maghintay doon.

translations.EN: I'll wait at the assigned marker.
translations.TL: Maghihintay ako sa iniatas na marka.

translations.EN: Moving to wait as ordered.
translations.TL: Kikilos para maghintay ayon sa utos.

translations.EN: Sounds good. Going to wait there.
translations.TL: Maganda 'yan. Pupunta para maghintay doon.

translations.EN: Finished waiting.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang paghihintay.

translations.EN: Done waiting. What's the next move?
translations.TL: Tapos nang maghintay. Ano ang susunod na galaw?

translations.EN: Wait time concluded. Ready for orders.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang oras ng paghihintay. Handa sa utos.

translations.EN: Held the spot. Standing down now.
translations.TL: Nahawakan ang pwesto. Uurong na ngayon.

translations.EN: Waiting task complete.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang gawaing maghintay.

translations.EN: Done holding this ground.
translations.TL: Tapos na sa paghawak ng lupang ito.

translations.EN: Time is up. Finished waiting here.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang oras. Tapos nang maghintay dito.

translations.EN: Rejoining you. Wait is over.
translations.TL: Sasama muli sa 'yo. Tapos na ang paghihintay.

translations.EN: Held the post as long as needed.
translations.TL: Nabantayan ang poste hangga't kinakailangan.

translations.EN: Completed the wait order.
translations.TL: Natapos ang utos na maghintay.

translations.EN: I couldn't wait there.
translations.TL: Hindi ako nakapaghintay roon.

translations.EN: Position was overrun. Couldn't keep waiting.
translations.TL: Pinamugaran ang pwesto. Di nakapagpatuloy maghintay.

translations.EN: Enemies forced me out of the waiting spot.
translations.TL: Itinaboy ako ng kalaban mula sa pwesto ng paghihintay.

translations.EN: Couldn't reach the designated waiting location.
translations.TL: Di narating ang itinalagang lugar ng paghihintay.

translations.EN: Unable to hold ground there. Too dangerous.
translations.TL: Di mahawakan ang lupa roon. Masyadong mapanganib.

translations.EN: Waiting failed. Had to relocate for safety.
translations.TL: Pumalpak ang paghihintay. Kinailangang lumipat para sa kaligtasan.

translations.EN: Aborted waiting. Sector became hostile.
translations.TL: Itinigil ang paghihintay. Naging delikado ang lugar.

translations.EN: I had to abandon the post.
translations.TL: Kinailangan kong iwan ang poste.

translations.EN: Could not remain stationary there.
translations.TL: Hindi nakapanatiling nakatigil doon.

translations.EN: Failed to hold the wait point.
translations.TL: Bigo sa paghawak ng pwesto ng paghihintay.

translations.EN: I can't wait there right now.
translations.TL: Hindi ako makapaghintay roon ngayon.

translations.EN: That spot is in the line of fire. I won't wait there.
translations.TL: Nasa linya ng putukan ang pwestong 'yon. Di ako maghihintay doon.

translations.EN: Standing out in the open like that is suicide.
translations.TL: Pagpapakamatay ang tumayo sa bukas na lugar nang ganoon.

translations.EN: Refusing to wait in an unsecured position.
translations.TL: Tumatangging maghintay sa di-ligtas na posisyon.

translations.EN: Too many hostiles nearby to just stand around.
translations.TL: Masyadong maraming kalaban sa paligid para tumayo-tayo lang.

translations.EN: I need to stay on the move. Can't wait there.
translations.TL: Kailangan kong gumalaw. Di makapaghihintay doon.

translations.EN: Wait order rejected. Find a safer spot.
translations.TL: Tinatanggihan ang paghihintay. Maghanap ng mas ligtas na lugar.

translations.EN: I won't wait in a compromised sector.
translations.TL: Di ako maghihintay sa delikadong lugar.

translations.EN: Unable to comply. That location has zero cover.
translations.TL: Di makasusunod. Walang silong ang lugar na 'yan.

translations.EN: I can't wait at that position.
translations.TL: Di ako makapaghihintay sa posisyong 'yon.
